title: Sandwich, With a Side of Romance by Krista Phillips
description:
Novels & Nibbles has fallen for a lighthearted romance this week. Maddie Buckner moves to the small town Sandwich, Illinois, determined to build a better life and reunite with her brother who’s in foster care. After a disastrous first day, she finds herself working for a grumpy sandwich shop owner she affectionately calls “Reuben-the-Jerk”. Sparks start to fly, misunderstandings pile up, and Maddie discovers that sometimes the people we least expect can change our lives the most.

In honor of “Reuben-the Jerk” we are featuring The Classic Reuben Sandwich. A match made in deli heaven with tender corned beef, melted Swiss cheese, tangy sauerkraut, and creamy Russian dressing nestled between two perfectly grilled slices of marbled rye from The Bread Shop PBO. The romance of this sandwich is a little sweet, a little tangy, but guaranteed to leave you wanting more.

This Reuben is warm, messy and impossible to resist just like a good love story. Come experience it for yourself.
